name: Robe of Stars

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

powers.name: Throw a star (Magic Missile, level 5)
powers.text: Pull off a star: cast Magic Missile as a level 5 spell.

powers.name: Enter the Astral Plane

params.text: flickers toward the Astral Plane, but Barovia's mists hold fast

powers.text: Magic action: you and what you wear go to the Astral Plane (the Mists of Barovia hold you fast).

summary: +1 to saving throws; six stars to throw as level 5 Magic Missiles (they return at dusk).
text: A black or deep-blue robe stitched with tiny white or silver stars; wearing it adds +1 to your saving throws. Six oversized stars sit across the upper front. As a Magic action you can tear one free and use it to cast Magic Missile at level 5. Each dusk, 1d6 of the torn-off stars grow back. Another Magic action carries you, with all you wear and carry, into the Astral Plane, where you stay until you spend a Magic action to go back to the plane you left.
